title: Who is a Clearing Agent? - Uganda Revenue Authority
text:
# Who is a Clearing Agent?
This is an individual employed by an entity licensed under S.145 as a clearing firm. A clearing agent is a professional who has been trained to handle all customs clearance processes and procedures required to declare goods and send them to their destination.
